questions.stem: In cerebral palsy, which airway problems should the anaesthetist anticipate?
questions.answer: Poor dental hygiene, neck contractures, TMJ dislocation, aspiration (reflux, bulbar dysfunction)

questions.answer: Lesions of the motor pathways in the developing brain

questions.stem: In cerebral palsy, what is the severe end of the severity range?
